clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Egalin's Grimoire holds the rites for summoning and commanding a voidwalker. A master warlock wrote it as a teaching text for the Temple of the Damned.

Egalin's Grimoire records how to call a being of chaos from the Nether. Egalin was a master summoner, renowned for his effortless command of voidwalkers. He passed that skill to his students, including Carendin Halgar. Without the formulas and channeling methods in the book, an unprepared summoner risks being torn apart by the being they call forth.
